exemptions.reason: pgx memory-safety advisory; fixed in pgx v5.9.0. govulncheck classifies as package-result (imported, NO reachable call path — opendbx uses only pgxpool New/Ping/QueryRow/Close, not the vulnerable symbols). pgx v5.9.0's go.mod declares go 1.25.0, so the fix would force the whole project go 1.24.0 → 1.25 (the bump spec-1.18 R2 deliberately avoided). Accepted as not-reachable + go-version-locked; revisit when the toolchain bumps to go 1.25 (Stage 2+), at which point v5.9.0 is free.
exemptions.spec_ref: spec-1.18-pg-driver.md § 6 R-6 (post-impl T-10a security-reviewer HIGH-1; user path-3/3 keep v5.7.6)
